movies.title: Candlelight Letters
movies.synopsis: Two ex-lovers reconnect through a stack of unsent letters discovered in a piano bench.

movies.title: Autumn Station
movies.synopsis: A station florist keeps rearranging strangers lives while waiting for one train to be late, in a much lighter rom-com tone than a classic anniversary movie.

movies.title: Borrowed Moon
movies.synopsis: A widowed astronomer spends one week trying to return a stolen observatory key after strange signals start arriving from a dead satellite.

movies.title: Silver Postcards
movies.synopsis: A couple retraces the vacations shown on a box of old postcards and realizes each place now appears abandoned for a disturbing reason.
